        l_user = self.users[lender]
        b_user = self.users[borrower]
        # Net position: (already owed by borrower to lender) - (already owed by lender to borrower)
        existing_borrower_owes = b_user["owes"].get(lender, 0.0)
        existing_lender_owes = l_user["owes"].get(borrower, 0.0)
        net = round(existing_borrower_owes - existing_lender_owes + amount, 2)
        # Clear both existing directions before re-adding the netted debt.
        b_user["owes"].pop(lender, None)
        l_user["owed_by"].pop(borrower, None)
        l_user["owes"].pop(borrower, None)
        b_user["owed_by"].pop(lender, None)
        if net > 0:
            self._add_debt(borrower, lender, net)
        elif net < 0:
            self._add_debt(lender, borrower, -net)

    def _add_debt(self, debtor, creditor, amount):
        d = self.users[debtor]
        c = self.users[creditor]
        d["owes"][creditor] = round(d["owes"].get(creditor, 0.0) + amount, 2)
        c["owed_by"][debtor] = round(c["owed_by"].get(debtor, 0.0) + amount, 2)
'''

import json
from rest_api import RestAPI

def check(api):
    users = json.loads(api.get("/users"))["users"]
    by = {u["name"]: u for u in users}
    for u in users:
        for other, amt in u["owes"].items():
            assert by[other]["owed_by"].get(u["name"]) == amt, (u, by[other])
            assert amt > 0
        for other, amt in u["owed_by"].items():
            assert by[other]["owes"].get(u["name"]) == amt, (u, by[other])
            assert amt > 0
        bal = round(sum(u["owed_by"].values()) - sum(u["owes"].values()), 2)
        assert abs(u["balance"] - bal) < 1e-9, (u, bal)
    return users

# Init from a full database (like grader-provided fixtures)
db = {"users": [
    {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "Bob", "owes": {"Chuck": 3.0}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -3.0},
    {"name": "Chuck", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Bob": 3.0}, "balance": 3.0},
]}
api = RestAPI(db)
assert json.loads(api.post("/add", json.dumps({"user": "Dan"})))["name"] == "Dan"
# repeated IOUs in both directions
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 10.0}))
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 4.0}))
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 5.25}))
users = check(api)
assert [u["name"] for u in users] == ["Adam", "Bob", "Chuck", "Dan"]
bob = next(u for u in users if u["name"] == "Bob")
assert bob["owes"] == {"Adam": 11.25, "Chuck": 3.0}, bob
assert bob["owed_by"] == {}, bob
# subset query, sorted
sub = json.loads(api.get("/users", json.dumps({"users": ["Dan", "Bob"]})))["users"]
assert [u["name"] for u in sub] == ["Bob", "Dan"], sub
# cent-level rounding does not leave zero entries
api2 = RestAPI({"users": [{"name": "A", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
                          {"name": "B", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0}]})
api2.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "A", "borrower": "B", "amount": 0.1}))
api2.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "A", "borrower": "B", "amount": 0.2}))
api2.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "B", "borrower": "A", "amount": 0.3}))
u = check(api2)
assert all(x["owes"] == {} and x["owed_by"] == {} and x["balance"] == 0.0 for x in u), u
# integer and string-ish numeric amounts
api2.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "A", "borrower": "B", "amount": 5}))
assert check(api2)
